brief:
The British government has designated Palestine Action as a terrorist organization, the Chris Hedges Report said, following the group's direct-action campaigns against Israeli weapons manufacturing. Palestine Action has targeted facilities and supply chains connected to Israel's military operations, drawing legal classification typically reserved for armed groups rather than activist organizations employing nonviolent disruption tactics.

The designation represents what supporters describe as suppression of Western dissent over Israel's conduct in Gaza. Palestine Action remains one of few organizations in Western countries using direct action to obstruct weapons systems they characterize as fueling Israeli military operations, according to reporting.
dek: Palestine Action is one of the only Western organizations utilizing direct action to impede the machinery of genocide fueling Israel’s apartheid project—triggering a full frontal attack from the West.
title: Britain designates Palestine Action as terrorist group over Israeli weapons disruption
